action: No action needed; for awareness. Fraud and compliance teams can expect a direct channel to law enforcement for scam-linked accounts, domains and wallets.
date_note: Published 19 November; The Record says the announcement was made Thursday.
exec: A new US federal unit aims to freeze scam payments and take down scam infrastructure faster, with private-sector partners able to act on shared intelligence.
org: US Department of Justice and Department of Homeland Security
plain: The US Justice and Homeland Security departments are launching a Threat Disruption Center to cut off the money flowing to overseas scam and cybercrime networks that target Americans.
summary: The Justice Department and Homeland Security announced a Threat Disruption Center inside the Homeland Security Task Force. According to The Record, it will triage victim complaints, map criminal networks and share intelligence with private partners, with TRM Labs supplying technology. The article cites IC3-reported cyber scam losses of $20.9 billion in 2025. Official releases were not read.
title: DOJ and DHS launch Threat Disruption Center against scams and cybercrime

validation.note: The Record read in full; DOJ/DHS releases not read.

review.note: Compared title, date (Thursday 19 Nov), unit name and placement in Homeland Security Task Force, TRM Labs role and 20.9 billion IC3 2025 figure against The Record article; single_source caveat accurate; severity 1 policy fits
